title: The Masked Ball
text: Music from a lit hall, a slow waltz, and through the tall windows dancers in masks turning in pairs. A doorman in livery bows and offers masks on a velvet tray. Nobody inside seems to have a face to put one over.

options.label: The most charming puts on a mask and goes in to dance, curious what lies beneath the others.

outcomes.text: They dance until the music stops, and a gloved hand presses a gift into theirs on the way out.
When the music stops, their mask will not come off for a while, and they do not want it to.

options.label: Refuse the masks at the door. You will keep your own faces, thank you.

outcomes.text: The doorman is offended. So is everyone inside, and they stop dancing, and turn.
